clue.text: A girl, last character coming forward to hold small dances

indicators.note: the reworked letters hold the next piece within them
the final letter of the phrase a girl is shifted up to the front of it

parts.note: a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: A young woman's dance card, with some detail about letters moving about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last character coming forward' moves the final S of ALASS to the front, giving SALAS; 'to hold' then puts S (small) inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a Latin American style of partner dancing, so salsas are such dances.

clue.text: Bandage the fellow after sharp blow

indicators.note: the fellow's piece is placed after the blow's piece

parts.note: a swat is a sharp slapping blow
he refers to a man, the fellow

explanation.surface: A man is bandaged up after being struck hard.
explanation.definitionFit: To swathe is to wrap something closely in cloth, much as one binds a wound.

clue.text: All may cry, endlessly troubled? Hard to keep 'teary'

indicators.note: the rearranged letters keep the next piece inside them
troubled letters are stirred up and rearranged
the word cry loses its final letter, having no end

parts.note: H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Everybody weeping when upset, with tears hard to hold back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' trims cry to CR; 'troubled' rearranges ALLMAYCR, and 'to keep' places H (hard) among those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Lachrymal is a formal adjective relating to tears or weeping, hence teary.

clue.text: Dealing with a seaman, providing internal support

indicators.note: the support goes internally, between the other letters

parts.note: OS stands for ordinary seaman
a prop is a support

explanation.surface: Handling a sailor who gives backing from within the crew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'internal' signals the insertion; an ordinary seaman is the lowest rating in the Royal Navy, and 'providing' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Apropos is a preposition meaning concerning or with regard to a matter.

clue.text: Outer layer of disintegrating comet flipping hot inside?

indicators.note: the flipped piece goes inside the rearranged comet
something disintegrating breaks up, so the letters of comet are scattered and rearranged
the word for hot is turned over, read backwards

parts.note: red-hot, so red stands for hot

explanation.surface: A comet breaking up and tumbling, perhaps hot at its core.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disintegrating' rearranges the comet's letters to ECTOM; 'flipping' reverses the colour for hot, and 'inside' places that within.
explanation.definitionFit: The ectoderm is the outermost germ layer of an embryo, giving rise to skin and nerves.

clue.text: Novel combination available in pub-restaurant?

definitions.meaning: A 1930 novel by W. Somerset Maugham
a pairing of cakes with ale (beer), as might be served in a pub that does food

explanation.surface: A new pairing offered on the menu of a gastropub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like an adjective meaning new, but it names the book.
explanation.definitionFit: Maugham's satirical novel takes its title from a Twelfth Night line about cakes and ale, food and drink.

clue.text: Eccentric theologian entertained by old boy meeting everyone

indicators.note: the two pieces meet, placed side by side
the theologian is held as a guest inside the old boy

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree
all means everyone

explanation.surface: A quirky divine hosted by a former pupil at a gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: An oddball is a strange or unconventional person, an eccentric.

clue.text: Writer and priest and where to find him

parts.note: Eli is the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible
Eli appears in the Old Testament, OT

explanation.surface: A writer and a clergyman, plus a note on where the cleric is found.
explanation.walkthrough: 'him' refers back to the priest, whose story is in the OT (Old Testament).
explanation.definitionFit: George Eliot and T. S. Eliot are both famous authors.

clue.text: Big bird, say, that has upset old man, getting in way

indicators.note: the following pieces get into the word for way

parts.note: a mode is a way or manner
eg, for example, is what say means

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the word upside down, read backwards

parts.note: pa is a father, an old man

explanation.surface: A large bird has knocked over an elderly man on the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns PA into AP; EG + AP 'getting in' MODE gives M-EGAP-ODE.
explanation.definitionFit: Megapodes are large-footed ground birds of Australasia, such as the mallee fowl, that build mound nests.

clue.text: Agreement to have nothing charged for instrument

indicators.note: the instrument is left with none of the charged piece, which is removed

parts.note: an accordion is a musical instrument
an ion is an electrically charged particle

explanation.surface: A deal under which a musical instrument is supplied free of charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'charged' stands for ION, a charged particle; 'to have nothing' removes it from ACCORDION.
explanation.definitionFit: An accord is a formal agreement or treaty.

clue.text: Son in jest out of control?

parts.note: kidding means joking, in jest

explanation.surface: A son's teasing has got out of hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A skidding car is sliding without grip, so out of the driver's control.

clue.text: Aspirations to accommodate sailors with very good instruments

indicators.note: the hopes make room for the next pieces inside them

parts.note: hopes are aspirations
RN is the Royal Navy, sailors
pi, short for pious, means very good

explanation.surface: Ambitions to house a crew of sailors along with excellent instruments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to accommodate' signals the insertion; pi for very good is crossword shorthand for pious.
explanation.definitionFit: A hornpipe is a reed wind instrument, as well as the sailors' dance named after it.

clue.text: Joiner-in given role here in Paris with quartet starting Christmas show

parts.note: a part is a role in a play
ici is French for here

indicators.note: only the opening four letters of the show are kept

parts.note: a pantomime is a traditional British Christmas-season stage show

explanation.surface: An actor cast in a Paris production joins a foursome opening a festive show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quartet starting' keeps only the first four letters; a pantomime is a comic family play staged in Britain around Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: A participant is someone who takes part, literally one who joins in.

clue.text: Behave badly in aerobatic display?

definitions.meaning: taken literally, a stunt pilot's act happens up in the sky

explanation.surface: Misbehaving during an air show.
explanation.definitionFit: Act up is an idiom for misbehaving; read literally it is a performance high overhead.

clue.text: Latin masters'd let fly — if Cicero's passage were this?

indicators.note: letters let fly scatter wildly and land in a new order

explanation.surface: Latin teachers might rage at a botched rendering of Cicero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let fly' rearranges LATIN MASTERSD; the setter squeezes 'had' into masters'd to get the D.
explanation.definitionFit: A passage of Cicero rendered wrongly into English would be badly translated, the very thing masters scold.

clue.text: Special treat, then, is very poor

indicators.note: a special arrangement of these letters is a new, rearranged order

explanation.surface: Offering a special treat that turns out to be awful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Special' signals rearranging TREAT THEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenth-rate is an informal intensifier of second-rate, meaning of extremely low quality.

clue.text: Article about one old African leader providing health supplement

indicators.note: the article goes round the next pieces

parts.note: the is the definite article
I is the Roman numeral for one
Idi Amin was the dictator of Uganda in the 1970s

explanation.surface: A news story on a former African dictator who sells vitamins.
explanation.definitionFit: Thiamine is vitamin B1, commonly taken as a dietary supplement.

clue.text: Superior group of islands, UK, maybe getting prior access? Delusion!

indicators.note: the access piece is placed before the others

parts.note: a hall is an entrance that gives access to a building
U denotes upper class, superior
CI is the Channel Islands
the UK is an example of a nation

explanation.surface: A posh archipelago, the UK perhaps, gaining early entry: what a fantasy!
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting prior' puts the access piece in front of the rest. The Channel Islands lie off the French coast; U as superior means upper class.
explanation.definitionFit: A hallucination is a false perception, something seen that is not there.

clue.text: Wail of female singer rising at start of event

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word reads upwards, backwards

parts.note: Lulu is a Scottish pop singer

indicators.note: only the first letter of event is taken

explanation.surface: A singer's lament as an event begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reverses LULU to ULUL; 'start of' takes E from event.
explanation.definitionFit: To ululate is to howl or wail in a high, trilling voice, especially in grief.

clue.text: Is oblivious to Italian ladies first to last

indicators.note: the opening letter is shifted to the very end of the word

parts.note: signore is the Italian plural of signora, ladies

explanation.surface: Pays no heed to Italian women, putting the first one last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first to last' moves the S of SIGNORE to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignore something is to take no notice of it, as if unaware.

clue.text: Dress up, as you might say — a requirement before the wedding?

indicators.note: spoken out loud the phrase gives the answer

parts.note: to preen up is to smarten oneself, dress up

explanation.surface: Getting dolled up, a must before a wedding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as you might say' signals the sound of PREEN UP.
explanation.definitionFit: A prenup is a prenuptial agreement, often demanded before marriage to settle assets.

clue.text: Notice one organisation we have left getting the last word

parts.note: an ad is a notice, an advertisement
I is the Roman numeral for one
the UK left the EU, the European Union, in 2020

explanation.surface: A notice about Brexit having the final say.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we' is the setter's Britain, which left the EU.
explanation.definitionFit: Adieu, French for goodbye, is the final word said on parting.

clue.text: What's not mainstream — popular before getting to fade away

indicators.note: the popular piece comes before the next

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular
to die away is to fade

explanation.surface: A trend that is briefly hip and then vanishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Indie music or film is independently produced, outside the commercial mainstream.

clue.text: Reported claim of captain destroying enemy ship — something giving sailors security?

indicators.note: reported speech, heard out loud, gives the answer's sound

parts.words: claim of captain destroying enemy ship
parts.note: a captain who has sunk an enemy vessel might boast I sank 'er

explanation.surface: A naval captain boasting of sinking a foe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reported' signals the sound of I SANK 'ER (I sank her).
explanation.definitionFit: An ice anchor secures a vessel to a floe of ice, keeping the crew safely moored.

clue.text: Country name given to an inhabitant of the Midwest

parts.note: India is a country

explanation.surface: A national name bestowed on someone from middle America.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'Indian' at the start is a false trail from a different continent.
explanation.definitionFit: An Indianan is a native of Indiana, a state in the US Midwest.

clue.text: Soldiers shouting possibly when receiving a command

parts.note: OR stands for other ranks, ordinary soldiers

indicators.note: the noise receives the next piece within it

parts.note: a din is a loud noise, of which shouting is one kind

explanation.surface: Troops yelling as they take an order.
explanation.definitionFit: To ordain is to decree or order formally.

clue.text: Iron is one of those heat-emitters in the home?

definitions.meaning: heating ... glow inside kettles, ovens and heaters

explanation.surface: A domestic iron and other things that warm the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Iron' suggests the household appliance, but it is the metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Chemical elements include iron; electrical elements are the resistive parts that heat appliances.

clue.text: A leak in which litres may come out

indicators.note: the litre abbreviation is placed in the leak

parts.note: to seep is to leak slowly

explanation.surface: A leak through which liquid may escape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in which' puts L inside SEEP. 'out' looks like part of the leak picture, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone out cold or out for the count is unconscious, like a sleeper.
